paite: "Pathian aw, na itna thupitak dungzui in ka tung ah zahngai inla; na lainatna thupi dungzui in ka tatleknate nulmang in.
heading: Bathsheba A-angkawm Thu A Zawlnei Nathan In Akiang Ak Thu Agen Nung A. David La / Ngaihdam Ngetna
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David, when Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.

paite: Ka thulimlouhnate hon silsiang vilvel inla, ka khelhna hon silsiangsak in.
english: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.

paite: "Ka tatleknate ka theigige ngal a, ka khelhna ka ma ah a-om nilouh hi.
english: For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.

paite: Na tung ah, na tung kia ah thil ka hihkhial a, na mitmuh in thil gilou ka na hihta hi; thu na gen a siamtang a na om theih a, vai na hawm a, gensiatbei a na omtheihna ding in.
english: Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.

paite: Ngai in, thulimlouhna a suktuah in ka om a; ka nu'n khelhna in ahon pai hi.
english: Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin.

paite: "Ngai in, sunggil ah takna na deih naknak a, akimu lou lam ah pilna na hon theisak ding hi."
english: Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.

paite: Hissop in hon siangsak inla, huchi in ka siang ding; hon silsiang lechin, vuk sang in ka ngouzaw ding hi.
english: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

paite: Nopna leh kipahna bil in hon zasak in; na guh suktante a kipahtheihna ding in.
english: Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.

paite: Ka khelhnate lak ah na mai sel inla, ka thulimlouhna tengteng nulmang in.
english: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.

paite: "Pathian aw, keimah ah lungtang siangthoutak siam inla; ka sung ah kha diktak siam thak nawn in.
english: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.

paite: Na kiang a kipan in hon paimang ke'nla; na Kha Siangthou hon laksak ke'n.
english: Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your Holy Spirit from me.

paite: Na hotdamna kipahna hon pe nawn inla; na Kha khut in hon len gige in.
english: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.

paite: Huchi in talekte na lampi tungtang ka hilh ding a; huchi in mikhialte nang lam anga nawn ding uhi.
english: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners will be converted to you.

paite: "Pathian, hon hondampa Pathian aw, sisan suahte lak ah hon tankhia in; huchi in ka lei in na diktatna thu kipaktak in la in asa ding hi.
english: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness.

paite: TOUPA aw, nang ka muk hong in; huchi in ka kam in na phatna a theisak ding hi.
english: Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise.

paite: "Kithoihna tung ah kipahna na nei ngal kei a; huchi hilou hileh ka pe ding a, halmang a thillat tung ah lungkimna himhim na nei kei hi.
english: For you don’t delight in sacrifice, or else I would give it. You have no pleasure in burnt offering.

paite: Pathian deihlam kithoihnate zaw kha khasia ahi. Pathian aw, lungtang khasia leh kisik tuntun na musit kei ding hi.
english: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. O God, you will not despise a broken and contrite heart.

paite: "Na deihlamtak in Zion tung ah thil hoih hih inla; Jerusalem kulh lem in.
english: Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in diktatna kithoihnate tung ah kipahna na neita ding a, halmang a thillat leh halmang a pumpiak tung ah, huchi in na maitam tung ah bawngtalte alanta ding uh.”
english: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt offerings and in whole burnt offerings. Then they will offer bulls on your altar.
